_source: MMG_v19_Client_Manual_Testing_Guideline_FG05-FG14_v1.0.xlsx / Testing Guideline — the copy pulled from the client's Google Drive on 2026-09-16. FG-14 'Integration Monitoring & Logging' holds 4 cases: TC-LOG-001, -002, -004, -005. All 4 are implemented.
_target: Odoo 19 only. omni.log.status gained a 'cancelled' value in the port (omni_log/models/omni_log.py:67-80) as the companion to queue_job_enhancement's set_as_overridden, and TC-LOG-001's closing note is about exactly that value.
_safety: omni.log holds 6.8 million of the client's own rows. Unlike queue.job it is an ordinary model, so every state-changing assertion here runs against rows the suite creates, marked FG14-AUTOMATED-PROBE in entity_name and removed in a finally; the client's rows are read and counted, never written. The one thing that must never happen is a SUCCESSFUL re-run: omni.log.run() dispatches into the live Shopify connector (omni_log.py:287-305), so multi_import and multi_export are called only on selections their guards must refuse — an export row on the import action, a draft row, a resolved row. Each raises before run() is reached.
_residual_manual: Reading the screen's pre-applied Draft/Failed/Unresolved filters with a tester's own eyes (TC-LOG-001 step 3 — the per-store action carries no search_default_* keys on this build, so what a tester sees depends on their own last-used filters); pressing a re-run button (the workbook forbids it too).

_findings.BC-FG14-001: P1, and the workbook states the expectation directly. omni.log.status gained 'cancelled' in the v19 port, but omni_log/views/base_omni_log_views.xml offers NO Cancelled filter (only Draft/Success/Failed at lines 14-20) and the status column's decorations cover only done/failed/draft (lines 92-95 and 161-164). An entry in that status is therefore invisible to every filter on the screen and renders with no colour. TC-LOG-001's closing note says 'Novobi added a filter and a colour for it during the upgrade — confirm you can filter on it'; it was not added. Two lines of view XML per list. Reported by TEST-FG14-LOG-001, which FAILS on it.
_findings.OBS-FG14-001: omni.log.multi_resolved and multi_unresolved both guard with any(status in statuses for status in ['draft', 'success']) (omni_log.py:366-377), but 'success' is not a value of omni.log.status — the field's values are draft/done/failed/cancelled, and the SUCCESS label belongs to 'done'. So the guard only ever catches Draft, and a SUCCESSFUL entry can be bulk-unresolved from the Actions menu. Confirmed live: multi_unresolved on a done entry cleared its is_resolved flag with no error. The form's own buttons prevent this correctly (Unresolve carries invisible="not is_resolved or status == 'done'"). One-word fix: 'success' -> 'done' in both guards. Recorded by TEST-FG14-LOG-004 but NOT counted against it: TC-LOG-005 step 12 words its expectation about the form, and the form is right. This belongs on Novobi's defect list, not in the client's acceptance verdict for TC-LOG-004.
_findings.OBS-FG14-002: The Product Export log screen covers TWO operation types — export_master and export_mapping, the master product and its listing — where every other screen covers one. Not a defect; recorded because a test asserting 'exactly one' would fail on it.

TC-LOG-001.reason: FAILS on BC-FG14-001. Everything else passes: all seven store-card log actions scoped to their store and their operation types, each titled with the store and each covering a distinct set; the import list's six columns and its 'Imported by'; the four status values and their labels; a real failed entry's fields, message and payload; the link back to the record; search by ID on Store; group by Status; and the export list's 'Exported by' and Action column.

TC-LOG-002.reason: The Re-Import button's gating spelled out as the three cases the workbook compares, and both refusals — an already-successful entry, and an export log — checked on the message AND on the rows afterwards. The mirror case (Re-Export on an import log) is checked too. The happy path is never taken.

TC-LOG-004.reason: The four Actions-menu server actions, their bindings and the method each runs, plus the complement; three entries marked resolved together and unresolved again, with their statuses untouched throughout; and the Draft refusal, which leaves even the qualifying entry in the selection unchanged. OBS-FG14-001 is recorded here.

TC-LOG-005.reason: The full resolve/unresolve round trip on a scratch failed entry, including that the Status reads Failed throughout — resolving is a housekeeping flag, not a change of outcome — and the two toggle_resolved buttons with their opposite gating expressions.
